subject: english
stem: Text: The town planted fifty trees last spring; forty-seven are still growing. Which statement is explicit?
options: The town planted the most trees in the country
Three of the trees are no longer growing
The three trees died from heat
This spring will have more trees

optionRationales.reason: The town planted the most trees in the country：沒有全國比較。
Three of the trees are no longer growing：50 減 47 得 3，完全由明示數量推出。
The three trees died from heat：原因 heat 未提。
This spring will have more trees：未提供本春計畫。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「選項每一部分都能由原文字句直接支持」可推出 Three of the trees are no longer growing；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Three of the trees are no longer growing 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
